name: Purge in Flames deals damage to all units except your champion
notes: Purge in Flames' element is FIRE, matching the starting champion, so no lineage patch is needed. Two extra Fairy Whispers are seeded into hand as reserve-payment fuel since the full 8-reserve cost (no Efficiency discount at champion level 0) needs more fuel than a natural hand provides. The ability's own damage resolution fires directly after the last reserve payment with no separate opportunity-window PASS needed. IsClassBonusActive($player) with no class filter evaluates true for the default champion, so the observed damage is 3 (the [Class Bonus] amount) rather than the base 2 -- the seeded Dungeon Guide (3 life) is killed by it, and the opposing champion takes 3 damage too.

rulesClauses: Deal 2 damage to all units except for your champion. Class Bonus: Deal 3 damage to those units instead.
